face.name: 斯雷特教授
face.text: 你的法术具有剧毒。
face.flavorText: “别怕，很快就结束了。可能你感觉起来会无比漫长，但我向你保证，其实真的很快！”

face.name: Professor Slate
face.text: Your spells are Poisonous.
face.flavorText: "Don’t worry, this will be over in a second. It might FEEL like an eternity, but I assure you, it’s quite quick!"

face.name: 金牌猎手克里
face.text: 你的其他角色在攻击时免疫。
face.flavorText: 大师级猎手，喜好赢得比赛和吃冰淇淋。

face.name: Ace Hunter Kreen
face.text: Your other characters are Immune while attacking.
face.flavorText: This grandmaster marksman loves winning tournaments and eating a bit of ice cream.

face.name: 死神4000型
face.text: 同时对其攻击目标相邻的随从造成伤害。
face.flavorText: 对于田里的庄稼来说，所有的收割机都是死神。

face.name: Foe Reaper 4000
face.text: Also damages the minions next to whomever it attacks.
face.flavorText: Foe reaping is really not so different from harvest reaping, at the end of the day.

face.name: 侏儒飞行员诺莉亚
face.text: 突袭。同时对其攻击目标相邻的随从造成伤害。亡语：对所有敌人造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 着陆动作极为暴力。

face.name: Gnomelia, S.A.F.E. Pilot
face.text: Rush. Also damages minions next to whomever this attacks. Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
face.flavorText: Never learned how to L.A.N.D.

face.name: 踏韵舞者丽萨
face.text: 突袭。在你的英雄攻击后，将本随从移回你的手牌并使其法力值消耗变为（1）点。
face.flavorText: 向左一个暗影步！向右一个二段跳！这就是交叉职业！

face.name: Rhythmdancer Risa
face.text: Rush After your hero attacks, return this to your hand and set its Cost to (1).
face.flavorText: Shadowstep to the left! Double jump to the right! Class cross!

face.name: 金手指纳克斯
face.text: 在纳克斯攻击一名随从后，还会命中敌方英雄。
face.flavorText: 在龙蛇混杂的加基森没点装备怎么行？作为污手党的头号打手，纳克斯正是凭借这一对指虎为其赢得了“金手指”的名号。

face.name: Knuckles
face.text: After this attacks a minion, it also hits the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: When confronted with accusations of performance-enhancing bananas, Knuckles replied, "I get my fruit from trees I knock down with my bare hands like everyone else."

face.name: 锻石师
face.text: 战吼：在本局对战的剩余时间内，你的图腾拥有+2攻击力。
face.flavorText: 她可是“石纹锻字”的匠人。

face.name: The Stonewright
face.text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, your Totems have +2 Attack.
face.flavorText: She wrights stone better than she reads it.

face.name: 救赎者洛萨克森
face.text: 战吼：在本局对战的剩余时间内，在你召唤一个白银之手新兵后，使其获得圣盾。
face.flavorText: 体内灌注的圣光过于耀眼，晚上睡觉的时候不得不戴上双层眼罩。

face.name: Lothraxion the Redeemed
face.text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, after you summon a Silver Hand Recruit, give it Divine Shield.
face.flavorText: So infused with the Light, he has to wear double sleep masks at night.

face.name: 恒星之火萨鲁恩
face.text: 战吼：使你牌库中的所有元素获得火焰法术伤害+1。
face.flavorText: 萨鲁恩诞生于超新星碰撞时的热寂之中，要将其周遭的物质尽数烧毁，化作星尘！！烧个干净！

face.name: Saruun
face.text: Battlecry: Give all Elementals in your deck Fire Spell Damage +1.
face.flavorText: BORN FROM THE HEAT DEATH OF COLLIDING SUPERNOVAS, SARUUN SEEKS TO INCINERATE ALL THAT WHICH REVOLVES AROUND THEM TO MERE ASHES AND STARDUST!!!! Which is pretty neato!

face.name: 哈杜伦·明翼
face.text: 战吼：使你手牌和牌库中所有奥术法术牌获得法术伤害+1。
face.flavorText: 我本想要一张随机的传说随从，却没想到明翼并不是光明之翼的简称。

face.name: Halduron Brightwing
face.text: Battlecry: Give all Arcane spells in your hand and deck Spell Damage +1.
face.flavorText: I wanted to generate a legendary, but I held da wrong Brightwing.

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

local_policies: Ten real roots, exact existing CS2_101t/1652 token and MIS_701 evidence; full24 bilingual primary faces and all732 original source identities/order/roles retained. No new generated physical card or actual pool crop.

Slate extends only friendly_spells to Poisonous through original live keyword aura/hand display and ordinary health/frozen split source. Existing Fel-only scope remains Lifesteal-only; no after-damage destruction listener. Kree grants existing immune-while-attacking to friendly hero and other friendly minions, not itself or idle defenders.

Reaper and Noralia use original native cleave and shared combat batch/physical neighbors, not extra attacks or card-layer damage. Noralia has actual Rush and ordinary DR enemy-character2damage. Risa has Rush and returns current original living source with set-cost1 after actual own hero completed attack; enemy hero/minion attacks do not qualify.

Knuckles follows its original actual attacking COMBAT HealthResult, matching the unique open declared character attack and original source residence/defender Minion. Reciprocal defender hits, bare Damage(COMBAT), cancelled attacks, spells and hero defenders are excluded. The accepted original packet captures the native callback before the ordinary death checkpoint, so lethal retaliation does not erase the hit. The ordinary direct MINION_ABILITY damage uses captured current Attack and opponent of original controller; no second attack, Spell Damage, or copied health executor. Exact CN ordering relative to health observers and attack_finished remains recorded local policy, not official calibration.

Stonewright installs one persistent original-player current active-board Totem Attack+2 scope, including actual current tribal changes and all-tribe minions; no static executable-only identity list or hand/deck buff. Lothraxion installs one persistent original-player actual successful Recruit entry trigger; the original summon receipt protects against same-ID leave/reentry, source later death/control/silence does not revoke the program.

The Silver Hand identity predicate preserves all9 positive raw tag3444 Minion faces, full rows/order/hash including variants not currently registered. This is a structural condition, not9 effect or generation-scope certifications; no extra Classic/Wild root scope. The actually used CS2_101t/1652 current host token is independently preserved.

Saruun captures full current physical deck Elementals and grants exact removable Fire Spell Damage+1 through the existing stored-grant material and school-aware source query. No hand/board/enemy grant; grants survive source death and ordinary draw/play/current copy, and normal silence/backward reset remove them. Granted magnetic transfer uses existing attachment provenance; old native school declarations remain constrained by their original policy. No global player Spell Damage cache.

Halduron uses existing physical spell grant for all original own hand/deck Arcane spells; whole accepted references keep original residence and source, later acquisition is outside the batch. Actual spell CAST/whole-budget damage uses existing local spell bonus capture.

No formal pool/Standard/CN completeness claim. Fixed version/hotfix and CN rules edges deferred; unknown source members/semantics remain explicit, MIS_701 and YOG_522 and six original domains stay open.
